name: rating-player-744-NFL
reading: Sam LaPorta's 2026 season profile shows elite relative standing in air yards responsible (90.6th percentile) and strong relative standing in points responsible (89.4th percentile) within a cohort of 828 players. These measurements are based on only five recorded appearances, a thin sample that limits the reliability of the rankings. No prior season comparison is supplied.
review: Does this fulfill the character's purpose? Is its central reading supported? Record material errors separately from awkward wording and processing cost.
